description_expanded:
Indulge in Gulf views from the balconies of this fourth floor Lucian residence. Located on the top floor, this spacious condominium overlooks the Amphitheater and the growing Alys Beach Town Center. The 3 bedroom, 3.5 bath open-floor plan features three balconies allowing for entertaining, expansive views to the south and plenty of natural light. The residence’s fireplace separates the east and southern balconies off the dining, kitchen, and living areas with the 3rd balcony private to the primary suite looking south. This coastal contemporary lifestyle home has both stunning gathering spaces as well as private bedroom suites. Guests enjoy parking in an underground parking area for one vehicle adjacent to the Amphitheater. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, the Silva Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Primary Bedroom

1 King

Guest Bedroom #1

1 King

Guest Bedroom #2

1 Queen

Bunkroom

2 Twin/Twin Bunk
